preservedUnknownSections.body:
**Mission:** `chat-thread-closeout-autopsy-harvest-chatgpt-v1`  
**Lane:** `CHAT_CONTEXT_ONLY`  
**Protocol:** `v2.1`  
**Mode:** `DRAFT_FILE`  
**Target tier:** `T2`  
**Verdict:** `DRAFT_READY`  
**Closeout target:** `CHATGPT_SOURCE_PUBLISHED` — **not reached in this runtime because the required `CapitalGlass-Cross-Agent` Git staging surface is unavailable here.**

This thread contains durable, high-value Gold Mine intelligence. It records the transition from a receipt/SDLC-heavy Gold Mine corpus into a compounding improvement system with stable candidate identity, implementation-resolution semantics, full-open-population implementation, Gold Mine-ready harvest projections, warn-only schema validation, and the first v1.1/T2 reference harvest.

The dominant durable lesson is that **zero open Gold Mine candidates only means the currently observed corpus is exhausted; it does not prove estate-wide optimization when product workflows remain under-observed.**

The next evidence frontier is the real product estate: Computer Estimator, Human Estimator, Document Center / plan-set processing, Revu / Bluebeam, Bid Composer, Visual Asset Engine, Scraper, cross-app handoffs, operator intervention, latency, failures, retries, fallbacks, and business workflow friction.

preservedUnknownSections.title: 16. Do-not-advance guards
preservedUnknownSections.body:
1. **Do not declare the whole Capital Glass platform optimized because the current Gold Mine open population is 0.**
2. **Do not reopen resolved candidates solely because historical pre-fix evidence remains in the corpus.**
3. **Do not use ordinal Gold Mine IDs as cross-run authority. Use `candidateDigest` / digest-derived stable identity.**
4. **Do not treat `VERIFIED_FIX`, `ADOPTION_SIGNAL`, or `SUCCESS_PATTERN` as problem recurrence.**
5. **Do not hard-enforce the new Gold Mine projection schema after only one clean reference harvest; inspect 1–2 additional real harvests first.**
6. **Do not claim full milestone PASS before remote Git durability/parity is proven when durability is an acceptance gate.**
7. **Do not launch another infrastructure cleanup wave merely because it is easy to measure; prioritize real product-estate observation next.**
8. **Do not suppress LOW/deferred/uncertain but distinct valid signals from future harvests.**

preservedUnknownSections.title: #1 lesson
preservedUnknownSections.body:
When Gold Mine reports zero open candidates:

1. Start at the Gold Mine North Star charter.
2. Read the latest `productWorkflowCoverage`.
3. Read `corpusBias` / `underObservedDomains`.
4. Verify whether real product workflows were actually exercised.
5. Do not equate corpus exhaustion with platform optimization.
6. If major product surfaces are under-observed, create an observational proof wave before inventing another infrastructure batch.

preservedUnknownSections.title: #2 lesson
preservedUnknownSections.body:
When an implemented candidate reappears:

1. Correlate by `candidateDigest`, not `GOLD-####`.
2. Partition problem signals from resolution/adoption/success signals.
3. Confirm implementation proof and authority.
4. Use `RESOLVED_OBSERVED` / equivalent lifecycle state when appropriate.
5. Only reopen when **new problem evidence** proves persistence/regression.

preservedUnknownSections.title: #3 lesson
preservedUnknownSections.body:
When finalizing a milestone:

1. Inspect every acceptance gate.
2. Distinguish implementation completion from durable authority.
3. If Git parity is required but unproven, use PASS_WITH_WARN.
4. Upgrade to PASS only after remote parity evidence.
